# Lightning Desk

**One mouse and keyboard for every computer on your desk.**

Lightning Desk lets you move your mouse off the edge of one screen and onto the next
computer, type on whichever machine the pointer is on, and copy and paste or drag
files between them. Setup is a short guided walkthrough: pick the main computer,
link the others, put them in place, done.

- Windows, macOS and Linux (X11 and Wayland, including Hyprland and Sway)
- Encrypted connections between your computers (TLS)
- Copy and paste and file drag-and-drop across computers

## Download

Builds are published on the [Releases](https://github.com/cynthiaschomp/lightning-desk/releases) page.
